_help: First task per card (atlas/CURATION.md "First task contract"): one simple, read-only first step for a newcomer, human or agent. Only tasks a curator has done and verified are listed, with credit to the contributor. Cards without a task show no first-task block. Fields: title, steps, done_when, contributed_by, contributed_via, source_url, verified_by, verified_on, verification. steps is a list of 1-8 typed step objects from a closed set of actions, never free text; the sentence shown for each step is rendered by code: {"action": "open_page", "url": <https URL>, "label": <optional short label>}; {"action": "find_field", "field": <field name>, "each_has": <optional list of field names>}; {"action": "check_field", "each": <list field>, "field": <field name>, "match": {"key": <field name>, "equals": <value>, "has": <field name>}, "then_label": <label>, "else_field": <field name>, "else_label": <label>}. Field names: letters, digits, _ and . (starting with a letter or _, at most 64); labels: letters, digits, spaces and hyphens (at most 40). Validation fails closed: an unknown action, an unknown or missing key or a wrong type is an error; every URL (open_page url, source_url, any link in the text fields) must pass the one strict https validator (https_url_ok in site/cards_v2.py); no control, format or separator character anywhere; no `code` field and no download, install or run wording in the text fields.

touchstone.title: Check which clock a liveness record was measured on
touchstone.done_when: You can say which clock each checkpoint was measured on: tsa = an independent RFC 3161 timestamp, server = the server's own time.
